# Scaena — TV & Movie Tracker with Simkl Sync

> Scaena is a modern, privacy-focused media tracker and native Simkl companion client for TV shows, movies, and anime on iOS and iPadOS.

Scaena (pronounced "SEE-nuh") combines native Apple design aesthetics with Simkl synchronization, native spoiler protection, custom notifications, airing schedules, and widgets.

## Core Features
- **Simkl 2-Way Synchronization (AUTH V2)**: Seamlessly syncs watchlists, ratings, and watch history using modern OAuth with PKCE.
- **Rewatch Tracking**: Log and track isolated rewatch progress across multiple sessions per title without overwriting canonical watch history.
- **Native Spoiler Protection**: Hides episode descriptions behind spoiler alerts and replaces episode-specific thumbnails with season cover art until marked as watched.
- **Release & Airing Calendars**: Real-time schedules customized to the user's local timezone, with custom notifications.
- **Custom Lists**: Create, curate, and organize personal media lists synced via Apple iCloud, and browse Simkl custom lists (read-only, beta).
- **Watch Stats & Insights**: Track lifetime watch time and TV/Movie/Anime media breakdowns (Free), plus activity heatmaps, watch streaks, rating curves, weekday rhythm, release eras, top networks, backlog audits, and Hall of Fame (Pro).
- **List Snapshots & Web Sharing**: Export and share watchlists, default lists, and custom lists as interactive web pages. Automatically saves immutable snapshots under Settings → List Snapshots with CloudKit-backed instant revocation.
- **Home Screen Widgets**: Small, medium, and large glassmorphic widgets for Watchlist progress, Calendar schedules, and Custom Lists.
- **Localization**: Localized into 22 global languages.
- **Privacy Architecture**: Operates on a local Core Data container and private Apple iCloud Key-Value store. No third-party tracking, analytics, or remote user data collection.

## Platform Support
- **Supported**: iOS 18.0+, iPadOS 18.0+
- **Hardware Optimized**: Native layouts for iPhone 18 Pro, iPad Pro 13" (with sidebar navigation), and foldable dual-screen iPhone Duo.
- **macOS Note**: Not officially supported or optimized for macOS.

## Pricing Tiers
- **Free**: Core media tracking, up to 20 watchlist items, lifetime watch time & media breakdown, global recommendations, fixed-time release alerts, native spoiler protection, watchlist and default list snapshot sharing with CloudKit revocation.
- **Scaena Pro**: Unlimited watchlist items, 2-way Simkl synchronization, full Watch Stats & Insights (activity heatmaps, watch streaks, rating charts & Hall of Fame), Simkl rewatch tracking, Home Screen widgets, HD episode backdrops, custom themes & app icons, custom notifications, custom lists iCloud sync & custom list snapshot sharing.
  - Subscriptions: $1.99/month, $12.99/year (7-day free trial).
  - Lifetime: $34.99 one-time purchase.
  - Supports Family Sharing.
